sentences.text: "It is submitted that, in the instant case, according to the instructions of the appellants, both the appellants and respondents settled the matter amicably in between themselves.
Hence the appellants herein directed me to withdraw the instant appeal as infructuous.
Hence continuation of proceedings before this Hon'ble Court does not arise and the appellant herein seeking to withdraw the appeal as infructuous.
The same may be taken on record in the interest of justice and equity.
3. Memo is placed on record, leave as sought for is granted.
In view of the memo, this appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
